prompt.project_info: Photorealistic vertical 3:4 medium portrait of an original adult woman in a dark bathroom, styled as a polished comic-inspired superhero fashion editorial with smartphone-photography realism.
prompt.main_subject: One original adult woman with fair natural skin, long straight dark brown-black hair over the shoulders and back, symmetrical facial structure, defined brows, green-hazel eyes and a tiny generic eye mask. She has a natural curvy figure and wears a black halter-neck sleeveless superhero-inspired bodysuit with high-cut leg design, glossy purple accents, yellow trim and a bold generic bat emblem, plus black-and-purple opaque stockings. Keep fabric fitted and editorial without exaggerated body proportions or a public-figure likeness. Do not reproduce Megan Fox or any other public figure.
prompt.composition_elements: Stand the adult woman upright with weight shifted naturally to the right hip and torso slightly angled toward camera. Her right arm extends down with the hand resting on a speckled green-and-black granite countertop; her left arm hangs naturally by her side. Tilt the head slightly forward with direct eye contact and a calm confident expression. Use a centered eye-level slightly frontal 3:4 frame from thighs up. Include a wooden door with tall frosted glass panel, towel bar, dark walls, a generic comic-book hero poster and a small cyan neon sign reading 'KeorUnreal'.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffuse indoor artificial lighting from overhead and slightly frontal directions creates even illumination, gentle shadows and controlled highlights on the suit's glossy purple accents and bathroom materials. Keep the mood dark, confident, calm and comic-noir with natural contrast and saturation.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone-style 3:4 medium portrait, 50-85mm portrait focal length, moderate depth of field, sharp eyes, soft distinct background, realistic skin, fabric, granite, wood, glass and poster texture, low noise with minimal grain, no text or watermark except the specified neon sign.
